map.在左侧用 Markdown 缩进书写层级，右侧实时生成思维导图，支持缩放、拖拽与: Write the hierarchy on the left using Markdown indentation and see the mind map generated live on the right, with zoom, drag and export support.
map.📖 查看「思维导图编辑器 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Mind Map Editor User Guide"
map.做读书笔记或头脑风暴时，用 # 标题与 - 列表的缩进直接表达层级，右侧自动生成: When taking reading notes or brainstorming, express the hierarchy directly with # headings and indented - lists, and the mind map is generated automatically on the right, which is faster than drawing nodes by hand.
map.整理会议议题时，把中心主题放在一级、讨论点放在子级，缩进越深层级越深，结构一目了: When organizing meeting topics, put the central topic at level one and discussion points at child levels; the deeper the indent, the deeper the level, so the structure is clear at a glance.
map.准备汇报大纲时，先把要点写成 Markdown 大纲再导出图片，配合缩放、拖拽、: When preparing a report outline, write the key points as a Markdown outline first and then export an image, using zoom, drag and node collapse/expand for the presentation.
map.示例：用缩进语法写一张思维导图: Example: write a mind map with indent syntax
map.# 产品规划\n## 用户增长\n- 渠道投放\n- 活动裂变\n## 体验优化:
# Product Planning
## User Growth
- Channel Advertising
- Event Referral
## Experience Optimization
- Performance
- Interaction

Write on the left using indentation and the map is generated live on the right; scroll to zoom, drag to pan, and click a dot to collapse or expand child nodes. Click "Fit to Screen" before exporting PNG so the content displays fully.
map.如何调整节点层级？: How do I adjust node levels?
map.用 # 表示标题层级、用 - 列表表示子节点，缩进越多层级越深；Tab 键可快速: Use # for heading levels and - lists for child nodes; the more indentation, the deeper the level. The Tab key quickly indents to adjust subordination.
map.怎么导出完整思维导图？: How do I export the complete mind map?
map.支持导出 SVG 与 PNG；导出 PNG 前建议先点「适应屏幕」，确保所有内容: Export to SVG and PNG is supported; before exporting PNG, click "Fit to Screen" first to make sure all content falls inside the canvas without being cut off. Drafts are stored in localStorage.
